title: YukiChants-Standalone
body:
### Harbinger's Requiem:
 This gives Hoes higher damage similar to an axe

### Harbinger's Blaze:
 This is just fire aspect BUT for Hoes

### Scythe Master:
 This increases range by +2 Blocks and gives them a SWEEP attack

### Triple Shot:
 This is just multishot BUT for Bows!!!
